documentation.content: A consumer group's total lag has exceeded 10000 messages for more than 5 minutes — the consumer cannot keep up with the producer rate. For `execution-worker.pretest` / `execution-worker.system` this means submissions are queueing past the SLO; for `leaderboard-service.evaluated` it means the leaderboard is stale; for `analytics-clickhouse` it is non-critical (BI only). Inspect `system.kafka_consumers` (ClickHouse) or `kafka-consumer-groups.sh --describe` for the broker view.
